execution: Exhale and curl the shoulder blades off the floor by rounding the upper spine, about 30 degrees of movement. Hold one second, lower over 2 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Pulling on the neck with the hands. Trying to sit all the way up, which brings in the hip flexors. Yanking up with momentum.

name: Sit-up
setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and anchored or not. Arms crossed on the chest.
posture: Chin a fist's width from the chest, spine rounding smoothly rather than hinging in one block.
execution: Exhale and curl up one vertebra at a time until the torso is upright. Lower over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling, rolling down through the spine.
commonMistakes: Hooking the feet and yanking up with the hip flexors. Flinging the arms forward for momentum. Slamming back down.

name: Decline sit-up
setup: Set the decline bench to 15 to 30 degrees. Hook the ankles under the pads, arms crossed on the chest.
posture: Chin a fist's width from the chest, core braced, spine rounding smoothly.
execution: Exhale and curl up until the torso is upright. Lower over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling, and stop just before the shoulders touch down.
commonMistakes: Starting at too steep a decline. Free-falling backward between reps. Pulling on the neck.

name: Toe-touch crunch
setup: Lie on your back with the legs straight up toward the ceiling, arms reaching up toward the feet.
posture: Lower back pressed into the floor, legs held vertical and still, neck relaxed.
execution: Exhale and curl the shoulder blades off the floor, reaching the hands toward the toes. Hold one second, lower over 2 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Swinging the arms up for momentum. Letting the legs drop forward to meet the hands.

name: Plank
setup: Forearms on the floor, elbows directly under the shoulders, hands facing forward. Legs straight, feet hip width.
posture: Straight line from head to heels. Glutes squeezed, ribs pulled down, core braced hard, neck neutral with eyes on the floor.
execution: Hold for the set duration. Breathe shallow and steady through the nose. Stop the set when the hips start to drop rather than grinding out sloppy time.
commonMistakes: Hips sagging toward the floor, which loads the lower back. Piking the hips up to make it easier. Holding the breath.

name: V-up
setup: Lie flat on your back, arms extended overhead, legs straight.
posture: Lower back pressed toward the floor at the start, core braced, neck neutral.
execution: Exhale and lift the arms and legs at the same time, folding at the hips to meet over the middle. Hold one second, lower over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Bending the knees to make the lever shorter. Slamming the legs and shoulders down between reps.

name: Cable crunch
setup: Rope on a high pulley. Kneel facing the machine, rope held beside the ears, elbows tucked.
posture: Hips fixed in place, chest up at the start, hands locked beside the head throughout.
execution: Exhale and crunch down by rounding the upper spine, bringing the elbows toward the thighs. Squeeze one second, return over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Hinging at the hips instead of rounding the spine, which turns it into a pulldown. Letting the hands drift away from the head.

name: Machine crunch
setup: Set the seat and pad so the pivot lines up with your waist. Grip the handles.
posture: Back against the pad, chest up at the start, core braced, feet secured.
execution: Exhale and crunch forward by rounding the spine. Squeeze one second, return over 2 to 3 seconds under control.
commonMistakes: Pulling with the arms instead of the abs. Letting the stack slam down between reps.

name: Weighted dumbbell crunch
setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Hold one dumbbell against the chest or just above it.
posture: Lower back on the floor, chin a fist's width from the chest, neck relaxed.
execution: Exhale and curl the shoulder blades off the floor about 30 degrees. Hold one second, lower over 2 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Using the dumbbell's momentum to swing up. Adding weight before a bodyweight crunch is clean.

name: Ab wheel rollout
setup: Kneel on a mat with the wheel under the shoulders, hands gripping the handles. Start from your knees, not your feet.
posture: Ribs pulled down, glutes squeezed, lower back flat and locked. This position must not change during the rep.
execution: Inhale and roll forward as far as you can hold a flat back, then exhale and pull back to the start. Stop well short of full extension at first.
commonMistakes: Letting the lower back arch as you extend, which is the main injury risk. Rolling out further than you can pull back from.

name: Stability ball crunch
setup: Sit on the ball then walk the feet forward until the lower back is supported on the ball. Feet flat, hip width.
posture: Hips level, core braced, chin a fist's width from the chest, neck relaxed.
execution: Exhale and curl the shoulder blades up by rounding the spine. Hold one second, lower over 2 seconds into a slight backward stretch, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Letting the hips drop so the ball rolls. Using such a big range that the lower back overextends at the bottom.

name: Hanging leg raise
setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip at shoulder width, legs straight, body still.
posture: Shoulders pulled down away from the ears, ribs down, core braced hard so the body doesn't swing.
execution: Exhale and raise the straight legs until they reach at least hip height, tilting the pelvis up at the top. Lower over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Swinging and using momentum. Only raising the legs by hinging at the hip without tilting the pelvis. Dropping the legs fast.

name: Hanging knee raise
setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip at shoulder width, legs together.
posture: Shoulders pulled down away from the ears, ribs down, core braced so the body stays still.
execution: Exhale and raise the knees toward the chest, curling the pelvis up at the top. Lower over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Kipping the legs up with a body swing. Stopping at 90 degrees without the pelvic tilt, which skips the abs.

name: Captain's chair knee raise
setup: Forearms on the pads, hands gripping the handles, back against the pad. Legs hanging straight.
posture: Back flat against the pad, shoulders down away from the ears, core braced.
execution: Exhale and raise the knees toward the chest, curling the pelvis up at the top. Lower over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Swinging the legs up. Arching the back off the pad. Stopping short of the pelvic tilt.

name: Lying leg raise
setup: Lie flat on your back, legs straight and together, hands under the hips or beside them for support.
posture: Lower back pressed into the floor throughout. If it lifts, that is your range limit. Neck relaxed.
execution: Exhale and raise the straight legs to about 90 degrees. Lower over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling, stopping before the lower back peels off the floor.
commonMistakes: Letting the lower back arch on the way down, which is where injuries happen. Dropping the legs fast. Bending the knees to cheat.

name: Reverse crunch
setup: Lie flat on your back, knees bent at about 90 degrees, arms flat at your sides.
posture: Lower back pressed into the floor, neck relaxed, upper body still.
execution: Exhale and curl the pelvis up off the floor, bringing the knees toward the chest. Hold one second, lower over 2 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Swinging the legs to generate lift. Pushing off the floor with the hands. Simply pulling the knees in without lifting the pelvis.

name: Cable reverse crunch
setup: Ankle straps or a rope on a low pulley. Lie on your back with the feet toward the machine, knees bent at 90 degrees.
posture: Lower back pressed into the floor, upper body anchored by gripping something overhead.
execution: Exhale and curl the pelvis up off the floor against the cable, knees toward the chest. Hold one second, lower over 2 to 3 seconds.
commonMistakes: Letting the cable pull the legs straight fast. Arching the lower back at the bottom.

name: Flutter kick
setup: Lie flat on your back, legs straight, hands under the hips for support. Lift the heels about 15cm off the floor.
posture: Lower back pressed into the floor throughout, neck relaxed, shoulders down.
execution: Alternate small rapid kicks, one leg up and one down, staying within about 30cm of the floor. Hold for the set duration, breathing shallow and steady.
commonMistakes: Letting the lower back arch off the floor as fatigue sets in. Kicking so high the abs disengage.

name: Scissor kick
setup: Lie flat on your back, legs straight, hands under the hips. Lift both heels about 15cm off the floor.
posture: Lower back pressed into the floor, neck relaxed, core braced.
execution: Cross one leg over the other, then switch, in a steady scissoring rhythm for the set duration. Breathe shallow and steady rather than holding your breath.
commonMistakes: Lower back arching off the floor. Going so fast the movement becomes a flail.

name: Mountain climber
setup: Start in a push-up position, hands under the shoulders, body in a straight line.
posture: Hips level and low, shoulders stacked over the wrists, core braced, neck neutral.
execution: Drive one knee toward the chest, then switch legs in a steady running rhythm for the set duration. Breathe in a continuous rhythm, don't hold your breath.
commonMistakes: Letting the hips bounce up and down. Shoulders drifting behind the wrists. Going so fast the form collapses.

name: Dead bug
setup: Lie on your back with arms straight up over the shoulders and knees bent at 90 degrees over the hips.
posture: Lower back pressed flat into the floor throughout. This contact is the entire exercise. Ribs down, neck relaxed.
execution: Exhale and slowly extend the right arm overhead and the left leg straight out, stopping before the lower back lifts. Inhale and return, then switch sides.
commonMistakes: Letting the lower back arch as the limbs extend. Moving fast. Extending further than the core can hold.

name: Dragon flag
setup: Lie on a bench and grip it firmly behind your head. Only attempt this once hanging leg raises are easy.
posture: Body held in one rigid straight line from shoulders to toes, core braced extremely hard, shoulders pinned to the bench.
execution: Exhale and lift the whole body up so it pivots on the upper back. Inhale and lower slowly over 3 to 5 seconds, keeping the line, stopping before the hips sag.
commonMistakes: Attempting it before the core is ready, which strains the lower back badly. Piking at the hips. Dropping fast on the way down.

name: Russian twist
setup: Sit on the floor, knees bent, heels lightly touching down or lifted. Lean back to about 45 degrees.
posture: Flat back with the chest up, not rounded. Core braced hard, shoulders down.
execution: Exhale as you rotate the torso to one side, leading with the shoulders rather than just the arms. Inhale back through centre, then rotate to the other side.
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back at 45 degrees. Just swinging the arms while the torso stays square. Going fast enough to lose control.

name: Weighted Russian twist
setup: Sit on the floor, knees bent, leaning back to about 45 degrees. Hold one dumbbell with both hands at the chest.
posture: Flat back, chest up, core braced hard. Add weight only once the bodyweight version is clean.
execution: Exhale and rotate the torso to one side, moving the weight with the chest rather than the arms. Inhale through centre, then rotate the other way.
commonMistakes: Letting the back round under load. Swinging the weight with the arms alone.

name: Side plank
setup: Lie on one side, forearm on the floor with the elbow directly under the shoulder. Legs stacked, feet together.
posture: Straight line from head to feet, hips lifted and level, top shoulder stacked over the bottom, neck neutral.
execution: Lift the hips and hold for the set duration. Breathe shallow and steady. Lower under control and switch sides.
commonMistakes: Hips sinking toward the floor. Rotating the chest toward the floor. Elbow drifting out of line with the shoulder.

name: Bicycle crunch
setup: Lie on your back, hands lightly behind the ears, knees bent and lifted over the hips.
posture: Lower back pressed into the floor, chin a fist's width from the chest, elbows kept wide.
execution: Exhale and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg straight. Inhale and switch in a steady controlled rhythm.
commonMistakes: Pulling on the neck with the hands. Racing through reps so the rotation disappears. Letting the lower back lift off the floor.

name: Hanging oblique knee raise
setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip at shoulder width, legs together.
posture: Shoulders pulled down away from the ears, ribs down, core braced so the body doesn't swing.
execution: Exhale and raise the knees toward one shoulder, twisting at the waist at the top. Lower over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling, then alternate sides.
commonMistakes: Swinging the body to throw the knees across. Twisting only at the hips without lifting the pelvis.

name: Cable woodchopper
setup: Set the pulley high with a single handle. Stand side-on, feet slightly wider than the hips, grip with both hands.
posture: Chest up, flat back, core braced, knees softly bent. Hips pivot with the movement rather than staying locked.
execution: Exhale and pull the handle down and across the body toward the opposite hip, rotating through the torso and letting the back heel turn. Return over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Rotating from the lower back rather than through the hips and mid-back. Using only the arms. Standing too upright.

name: Pallof press
setup: Set the pulley at chest height with a single handle. Stand side-on, grip with both hands at the sternum, step out until taut.
posture: Feet shoulder width, knees softly bent, chest up, ribs down, core braced hard. Hips and shoulders square and locked.
execution: Exhale and press the handle straight out from the chest, resisting the cable's pull to rotate you. Hold 2 seconds, return over 2 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Letting the torso rotate toward the machine, which defeats the whole point. Going so heavy that the hips twist.

name: Cable side bend
setup: Single handle on the lowest pulley. Stand side-on and grip it with the near hand, arm straight at your side.
posture: Stand tall, chest up, feet hip width, free hand on the hip or behind the head. Movement happens only in the frontal plane.
execution: Inhale and let the cable draw you into a side bend. Exhale and pull back up to tall by contracting the opposite side. Hold one second at the top.
commonMistakes: Bending forward or twisting instead of bending directly sideways. Using so much weight the whole torso leans.

name: Dumbbell side bend
setup: A dumbbell in one hand at your side, arm straight. Free hand on the hip or behind the head. Feet hip width.
posture: Stand tall, chest up, shoulders level, movement strictly sideways with no forward lean or twist.
execution: Inhale and lower the dumbbell down the side of the leg. Exhale and pull back up to tall, squeezing the opposite side. Hold one second.
commonMistakes: Holding a dumbbell in each hand, which cancels the resistance out entirely. Twisting the torso as you bend.

name: Suitcase carry
setup: One heavy dumbbell in one hand at your side. Stand tall before moving.
posture: Shoulders and hips level and square, ribs stacked over the hips, core braced hard on both sides. Do not lean away from the load.
execution: Walk at a steady controlled pace for the set duration, resisting the pull to one side. Breathe shallow and steady. Switch hands for the next set.
commonMistakes: Leaning away from the weight, which removes the entire training effect. Shrugging the loaded shoulder up. Holding the breath.

name: Landmine rotation
setup: One barbell end in a landmine sleeve. Hold the free end with both hands at chest height, arms extended.
posture: Feet slightly wider than the hips, chest up, core braced. Hips pivot with the rotation, back heel free to turn.
execution: Exhale and sweep the bar in an arc from one hip to the other, rotating through the hips and mid-back. Control the return over 2 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Keeping the feet locked flat so the lower back absorbs the twist. Letting the bar drop rather than controlling the arc.

name: Machine torso rotation
setup: Set the seat and pad so the chest and legs are secured and the torso can rotate freely.
posture: Sit tall, chest up, hips locked in place by the pads, core braced.
execution: Exhale and rotate the torso to one side under control. Hold one second, return over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling. Complete all reps, then switch sides.
commonMistakes: Using a range far beyond comfortable rotation. Letting the weight stack snap you back to centre.

name: Barbell back squat
setup: Bar racked at upper-chest height, resting across the upper traps. Grip just outside the shoulders. Unrack and step back two paces, feet shoulder width, toes turned out 15 to 30 degrees.
posture: Chest up, ribs down, upper back tight, core braced hard as if about to be punched. Weight through the mid-foot, knees tracking over the toes.
execution: Inhale and brace. Sit down and slightly back until the hip crease drops below the knee, or as low as you can hold a flat back. Drive through the whole foot to stand, exhaling past the hardest point.
commonMistakes: Knees caving inward. Rounding the lower back at the bottom, the so-called butt wink. Rising with the hips first so the torso folds forward.

name: Barbell front squat
setup: Bar racked across the front delts and collarbone, elbows driven high so the upper arms are parallel to the floor. Feet shoulder width, toes out 15 degrees.
posture: Elbows up throughout, chest tall and vertical, ribs down, core braced hard. The torso stays far more upright than in a back squat.
execution: Inhale and brace. Squat straight down until the hip crease passes below the knee. Drive up through the mid-foot, exhaling, keeping the elbows high the whole way.
commonMistakes: Letting the elbows drop, which dumps the bar forward. Leaning the torso forward like a back squat. Gripping so tight the wrists strain instead of resting the bar on the shoulders.

name: Box squat
setup: Set a box or bench so that sitting on it puts the thighs at or just below parallel. Bar on the upper traps, feet shoulder width or slightly wider.
posture: Chest up, ribs down, core braced hard, shins close to vertical as you sit back.
execution: Inhale and brace. Sit back onto the box under control, pause for one second without relaxing. Drive up through the mid-foot and exhale.
commonMistakes: Flopping onto the box and bouncing off it, which loads the spine. Relaxing the core during the pause.

name: Zercher squat
setup: Bar cradled in the crooks of both elbows, held against the body. Use a pad or sleeve, this is uncomfortable. Feet shoulder width, toes out slightly.
posture: Chest up and very tall, elbows tucked in, upper back tight, core braced extremely hard. Start far lighter than your back squat.
execution: Inhale and brace. Squat straight down between the knees until the elbows are inside the thighs. Drive up through the mid-foot and exhale.
commonMistakes: Loading it like a back squat, which the arms and upper back cannot hold. Rounding forward as the bar drags the torso down.

name: Landmine squat
setup: One barbell end in a landmine sleeve. Hold the free end at chest height with both hands. Feet shoulder width, toes out slightly.
posture: Chest up, torso upright, core braced. The bar's arc naturally counterbalances you and keeps the torso vertical.
execution: Inhale, squat down until the thighs are at least parallel, letting the bar travel along its arc. Drive up through the mid-foot and exhale.
commonMistakes: Letting the bar drift away from the chest. Standing too close or too far so the arc fights you.

name: Goblet squat
setup: Hold one dumbbell vertically against the chest, cupping the top end with both hands. Feet shoulder width, toes out 15 degrees.
posture: Chest up, elbows tucked in, torso upright, core braced. The front load helps keep you vertical.
execution: Inhale, squat down until the elbows brush the inside of the knees. Pause briefly, drive up through the mid-foot and exhale.
commonMistakes: Letting the dumbbell drift away from the chest. Rounding the upper back as the weight pulls forward.

name: Kettlebell goblet squat
setup: Hold one kettlebell by the horns at chest height, bell resting against the sternum. Feet shoulder width, toes out slightly.
posture: Chest up, elbows tucked, torso upright, core braced, wrists straight.
execution: Inhale, squat down until the elbows brush the inside of the knees. Drive up through the mid-foot and exhale.
commonMistakes: Letting the bell pull the chest down. Letting the heels lift off the floor.

name: Leg press
setup: Sit with the back and hips flat against the pad. Feet on the platform at shoulder width, mid-height, toes turned out slightly.
posture: Lower back and hips glued to the pad throughout. This contact is non-negotiable. Head back, core braced.
execution: Release the safeties. Inhale and lower the platform until the knees reach about 90 degrees or just before the hips start to curl off the pad. Press up and exhale, stopping just short of locking the knees.
commonMistakes: Going so deep the lower back rounds off the pad, which is the main injury risk. Snapping the knees into full lockout. Letting the knees cave inward.

name: Hack squat machine
setup: Shoulders under the pads, back flat against the backrest. Feet shoulder width, mid-platform, toes out slightly.
posture: Back and hips flat against the pad, chest up, core braced, knees tracking over the toes.
execution: Release the safeties. Inhale and lower until the thighs are at least parallel. Drive up through the mid-foot and exhale, stopping just short of lockout.
commonMistakes: Placing the feet too low, which grinds the knees. Letting the hips curl off the pad at the bottom.

name: Smith machine squat
setup: Bar on the upper traps. Feet slightly ahead of the bar line, shoulder width, toes out 15 degrees.
posture: Chest up, ribs down, core braced. The fixed bar path means foot placement determines everything.
execution: Unrack with a wrist twist. Inhale and squat down until the thighs are at least parallel. Drive up and exhale.
commonMistakes: Feet placed directly under the bar, which forces the knees far forward. Relying on the machine and letting the core go slack.

name: Belt squat
setup: Attach the belt around the hips, load hanging between the legs. Feet shoulder width on the platform, toes out slightly.
posture: Chest up, torso tall, core braced. The spine carries no load, which is the whole point.
execution: Inhale and squat down until the thighs are at least parallel. Drive up through the mid-foot and exhale.
commonMistakes: Letting the belt ride up onto the waist rather than sitting on the hips. Leaning on the handles to pull yourself up.

name: Leg extension
setup: Set the seat so the knees line up with the machine's pivot, and the ankle pad rests just above the feet.
posture: Back flat against the pad, hands on the handles, thighs pressed into the seat, core lightly braced.
execution: Exhale and extend the knees until the legs are straight. Squeeze one second at the top, lower over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Swinging the weight up with a hip thrust. Letting the stack crash down between reps. Setting the pivot out of line with the knee.

name: Bulgarian split squat
setup: Stand about a stride in front of a bench. Place the top of the rear foot on it. Front foot far enough forward that the knee stays over the mid-foot at the bottom.
posture: Chest up, torso slightly forward, hips square, core braced. Weight through the front heel and mid-foot.
execution: Inhale and lower until the front thigh is parallel to the floor and the back knee is just off the ground. Drive up through the front foot and exhale.
commonMistakes: Front foot too close, forcing the knee far past the toes. Pushing off the back foot. Letting the hips rotate open.

name: Split squat
setup: Step into a split stance, front foot flat and rear heel lifted, feet about a stride apart and hip width laterally.
posture: Chest up, torso upright, hips square, core braced. Both knees track over the toes.
execution: Inhale and lower straight down until the back knee is just off the floor and the front thigh is parallel. Drive up through the front heel and exhale.
commonMistakes: Stepping the feet onto a tightrope line, which destroys balance. Pushing mainly off the back foot.

name: Walking lunge
setup: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Feet hip width.
posture: Chest up, torso upright, shoulders back, core braced, eyes forward.
execution: Inhale and step forward about a stride, lowering until the back knee is just off the floor and the front thigh is parallel. Exhale and drive through the front heel to step directly into the next lunge.
commonMistakes: Taking a short step so the front knee shoots past the toes. Letting the torso pitch forward. Letting the front knee cave inward.

name: Reverse lunge
setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Feet hip width.
posture: Chest up, torso upright, hips square, core braced.
execution: Inhale and step backward about a stride, lowering until the back knee is just off the floor. Drive through the front heel to return to standing, exhaling.
commonMistakes: Stepping back onto a narrow line and losing balance. Letting the front heel lift as you drive up.

name: Step-up
setup: Set a box or bench at a height that puts the thigh roughly parallel when the foot is on it. Dumbbell in each hand.
posture: Chest up, torso upright, core braced, whole working foot flat on the box.
execution: Exhale and drive through the working heel to stand up on the box, keeping the trailing leg passive. Lower over 2 to 3 seconds under control, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Pushing off the floor with the trailing leg. Choosing a box so high the hip has to twist. Dropping back down uncontrolled.

name: Bodyweight squat
setup: Stand with feet shoulder width, toes turned out 15 degrees. Arms out in front for balance.
posture: Chest up, ribs down, core braced, weight through the mid-foot, knees tracking over the toes.
execution: Inhale and sit down and back until the thighs are at least parallel. Drive up through the whole foot and exhale.
commonMistakes: Heels lifting off the floor. Knees caving inward. Rounding the lower back at the bottom.

name: Pistol squat
setup: Stand on one leg, other leg extended straight out in front. Arms forward for balance. Build up with a box or support first.
posture: Chest up, core braced hard, working foot flat with the whole sole down, knee tracking over the toes.
execution: Inhale and lower slowly on one leg until the hamstring meets the calf, keeping the free leg off the floor. Drive up through the whole foot and exhale.
commonMistakes: Attempting it before you have the ankle mobility, so the heel lifts. Collapsing into the bottom rather than lowering under control.

name: Sissy squat
setup: Stand tall, holding a support with one hand. Feet hip width, heels raised or on a small plate.
posture: Body held in a straight line from knees to head as you descend. Hips stay extended, core braced hard.
execution: Inhale and lean back, letting the knees travel forward while the hips stay open, lowering until the thighs are near the calves. Drive up by extending the knees, exhaling.
commonMistakes: Bending at the hips, which turns it into a normal squat. Going far deeper than the knees are conditioned for.

name: Wall sit
setup: Stand with your back flat against a wall, then walk the feet out and slide down until the thighs are parallel to the floor.
posture: Back flat against the wall, knees directly over the ankles at 90 degrees, chest up, core braced. Hands off the thighs.
execution: Hold the position for the set duration. Breathe steadily through the nose rather than holding your breath.
commonMistakes: Resting the hands on the thighs to take load off. Sliding up as fatigue sets in. Letting the knees drift past the toes.

name: Band squat
setup: Stand on the middle of a band, feet shoulder width, and bring the top over the shoulders or hold at chest height.
posture: Chest up, ribs down, core braced, knees tracking over the toes.
execution: Inhale and squat down until the thighs are at least parallel. Drive up through the mid-foot and exhale at the top, where band tension is highest.
commonMistakes: Letting the band pull the torso forward. Cutting the depth short because the top is the hardest part.

name: Lying leg curl
setup: Lie face down with the knees just past the edge of the pad and the ankle roller sitting just above the heels.
posture: Hips pressed into the pad throughout, chest down, hands on the handles, neck neutral.
execution: Exhale and curl the heels toward the glutes as far as they will go. Squeeze one second, lower over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Lifting the hips off the pad to swing the weight up, which is the most common fault here. Letting the stack drop fast.

name: Seated leg curl
setup: Set the back pad so the knees line up with the pivot. Lap pad snug over the thighs, ankle roller just above the heels.
posture: Back flat against the pad, hips pinned by the lap pad, core lightly braced.
execution: Exhale and curl the heels down and back as far as they will go. Squeeze one second, return over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Sliding forward out of the seat. Not tightening the lap pad, so the hips lift on every rep.

name: Standing leg curl
setup: Stand facing the machine, one leg against the roller just above the heel, hands on the handles.
posture: Stand tall, hips square, working thigh pressed against the pad, core braced.
execution: Exhale and curl the heel toward the glute. Squeeze one second, lower over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling. Complete all reps, then switch legs.
commonMistakes: Swinging the hip forward to help. Letting the torso lean back as the weight rises.

name: Glute-ham raise
setup: Set the foot plate and pad so the thighs rest on the pad and the ankles are secured. Start from a kneeling upright position.
posture: Straight line from knees to head throughout. Hips extended, glutes squeezed, core braced hard.
execution: Inhale and lower slowly over 3 to 5 seconds, keeping the body in one line. Exhale and pull back up using the hamstrings. Use your hands on the floor to assist early on.
commonMistakes: Bending at the hips on the way down. Attempting unassisted before the hamstrings can control the descent, which strains them badly.

name: Barbell Romanian deadlift
setup: Start standing tall with the bar at arm's length against the thighs, overhand grip just outside the legs. Feet hip width.
posture: Chest up, flat back, shoulders back, lats engaged, core braced hard. Knees held at a soft fixed 15 degree bend.
execution: Inhale and brace. Push the hips straight back, sliding the bar down the thighs until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, usually around mid-shin. Drive the hips forward to stand, exhaling.
commonMistakes: Turning it into a squat by bending the knees further as you descend. Rounding the lower back to chase depth. Letting the bar drift away from the legs.

name: Stiff-leg deadlift
setup: Bar on the floor. Feet hip width, overhand grip just outside the legs. Legs stay nearly straight throughout.
posture: Chest up, flat back, shoulders back, core braced hard. Knees almost locked but not hyperextended.
execution: Inhale and brace. Hinge at the hips to lower the bar toward the floor with near-straight legs, stopping where the back would round. Drive the hips forward to stand, exhaling.
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back to touch the floor. Locking the knees hard. Loading it like a conventional deadlift.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs, palms facing the body. Feet hip width.
posture: Chest up, flat back, shoulders back, core braced. Knees at a soft fixed 15 degree bend.
execution: Inhale and brace. Push the hips back, lowering the dumbbells down the front of the legs until you feel a hamstring stretch. Drive the hips forward to stand, exhaling.
commonMistakes: Letting the dumbbells drift forward away from the legs. Squatting instead of hinging.

name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
setup: Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in the opposite hand. Soft 15 degree bend in the standing knee.
posture: Hips square and level throughout, flat back, chest up, core braced. The rear leg extends behind as a counterweight.
execution: Inhale and hinge forward at the hip, lowering the dumbbell toward the floor while the free leg rises behind. Stop at a hamstring stretch, then drive the hip forward to stand, exhaling.
commonMistakes: Letting the hip of the free leg rotate open toward the ceiling. Rounding the back. Bending the standing knee to reach lower.

name: Kettlebell swing
setup: Kettlebell on the floor about a foot in front of you. Feet slightly wider than the hips. Hinge and grip the handle with both hands, then hike it back between the legs.
posture: Flat back, chest up, shoulders down and packed, core braced hard. This is a hip hinge, never a squat.
execution: Snap the hips forward explosively so the bell floats up to chest height, exhaling sharply and squeezing the glutes. Let it swing back between the legs as you inhale and hinge.
commonMistakes: Squatting the bell up instead of hinging. Lifting with the arms and shoulders. Hyperextending the lower back at the top.

name: Nordic hamstring curl
setup: Kneel on a pad with the ankles anchored under a bar or held by a partner. Body upright, arms crossed or ready to catch.
posture: Straight line from knees to head throughout. Hips extended, glutes squeezed hard, core braced.
execution: Inhale and lower as slowly as possible, resisting all the way, keeping the body in one line. Catch yourself with the hands and push back up. Exhale on the way up.
commonMistakes: Attempting full unassisted reps too early, which commonly causes hamstring strains. Bending at the hips instead of holding the line. Dropping fast.

name: Stability ball hamstring curl
setup: Lie on your back with the heels on top of a stability ball, legs straight, arms flat at your sides.
posture: Lift the hips so the body forms a straight line from shoulders to heels. Glutes squeezed, core braced, hips held high throughout.
execution: Exhale and pull the heels toward the glutes, rolling the ball in and keeping the hips lifted. Squeeze one second, extend back over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Letting the hips drop as the ball rolls in. Rushing so the ball wobbles out of control.

name: Band leg curl
setup: Anchor the band at floor level. Lie face down and loop the other end around one ankle. Scoot forward until there is tension.
posture: Hips pressed into the floor, chest down, core braced, neck neutral.
execution: Exhale and curl the heel toward the glute against the band. Squeeze one second, lower over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Lifting the hips to help. Letting the band snap the leg straight.

name: Barbell hip thrust
setup: Sit on the floor with the upper back against a bench edge, just below the shoulder blades. Barbell across the hips with a pad. Feet flat, shins vertical at the top.
posture: Ribs pulled down, chin tucked with eyes on the horizon throughout, core braced. Bench contact at the shoulder blades, not the neck.
execution: Inhale, drive through the heels and lift the hips until the torso is parallel to the floor. Squeeze the glutes hard for one second and exhale. Lower over 2 to 3 seconds.
commonMistakes: Hyperextending the lower back at the top instead of stopping at parallel. Letting the chin and ribs flare up. Pushing through the toes.

name: Sumo deadlift
setup: Bar over mid-foot. Take a wide stance with the toes turned out 30 to 45 degrees. Hinge down and grip inside the legs at shoulder width.
posture: Chest up, flat back, hips lower than in a conventional pull, shoulders over the bar, knees pushed out over the toes, core braced hard.
execution: Inhale and brace. Push the floor apart with the feet and stand tall, keeping the bar against the legs. Exhale at the top, then hinge back down under control.
commonMistakes: Letting the knees cave inward. Rounding the lower back. Jerking the bar off the floor before the slack is pulled out.

name: Machine hip thrust
setup: Set the seat and lap pad so the pad sits across the hips, not the belly. Feet flat on the platform, shins vertical at the top.
posture: Back against the pad, ribs down, chin tucked, core braced.
execution: Inhale, drive through the heels to extend the hips fully. Squeeze the glutes one second and exhale. Lower over 2 to 3 seconds under control.
commonMistakes: Pad sitting on the stomach instead of the hip crease. Arching the lower back to gain extra range.

name: Smith machine hip thrust
setup: Bench set beside the bar, upper back against it just below the shoulder blades. Bar across the hips with a pad. Feet flat, shins vertical at the top.
posture: Ribs down, chin tucked, core braced, shoulder blades on the bench.
execution: Unrack with a wrist twist. Inhale, drive through the heels until the torso is parallel to the floor, exhaling. Squeeze one second, lower over 2 to 3 seconds.
commonMistakes: Placing the bench so the fixed bar path doesn't line up over the hips. Hyperextending the lower back at the top.

name: Machine glute kickback
setup: Set the pad and chest support. Place one foot against the pad or footplate, hands on the handles.
posture: Chest against the pad, hips square, ribs down, core braced. The torso does not move.
execution: Exhale and drive the working leg back and up until the hip is fully extended. Squeeze one second, return over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back to gain extra range. Rotating the hip open as the leg goes back.

name: Hip abduction machine
setup: Set the pads against the outside of the thighs, knees bent, back flat against the seat.
posture: Back against the pad, chest up, core lightly braced. Lean slightly forward to bias the upper glutes.
execution: Exhale and press the knees apart against the pads as far as they go. Squeeze one second, return over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Letting the stack snap the legs back together. Rocking the torso side to side to push heavier.

name: Cable glute kickback
setup: Ankle strap on the lowest pulley. Face the machine, hold the frame, working leg strapped and slightly forward.
posture: Chest up, hips square, ribs down, core braced. Slight forward lean from the hips, torso still.
execution: Exhale and drive the leg back and up until the hip is fully extended. Squeeze one second, return over 2 to 3 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back rather than extending the hip. Swinging the leg with momentum.

name: Cable pull-through
setup: Rope on the lowest pulley. Face away from the machine, reach between the legs and grip both ends. Step forward until taut, feet shoulder width.
posture: Chest up, flat back, core braced, knees at a soft fixed bend.
execution: Inhale and push the hips straight back, letting the rope travel between the legs until you feel a hamstring stretch. Drive the hips forward to stand and squeeze the glutes, exhaling.
commonMistakes: Squatting down instead of hinging back. Pulling with the arms rather than driving with the hips. Hyperextending the lower back at the top.

name: Glute bridge
setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip width, heels about a hand's length from the glutes. Arms flat at your sides.
posture: Ribs pulled down, chin tucked, core braced, lower back neutral rather than arched.
execution: Exhale and drive through the heels to lift the hips until the body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze one second, lower over 2 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back to lift higher instead of stopping at a straight line. Pushing through the toes. Letting the knees fall apart.

name: Single-leg glute bridge
setup: Lie on your back, one knee bent with the foot flat, the other leg extended straight or knee hugged to the chest.
posture: Hips level and square throughout, ribs down, core braced, chin tucked.
execution: Exhale and drive through the working heel to lift the hips until the body forms a straight line. Squeeze one second, lower over 2 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Letting the free-leg hip drop, which lets the strong side take over. Arching the lower back to gain height.

name: Frog pump
setup: Lie on your back, soles of the feet pressed together, knees fallen out wide, heels drawn toward the glutes.
posture: Ribs down, core braced, chin tucked, lower back neutral.
execution: Exhale and drive through the outer edges of the feet to lift the hips. Squeeze the glutes hard for one second, lower over 2 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back to lift higher. Letting the knees drift back together.

name: Donkey kick
setup: On all fours, hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips. Spine neutral.
posture: Flat back like a tabletop, hips level and square, core braced, neck in line with the spine.
execution: Exhale and drive one heel toward the ceiling, keeping the knee bent at 90 degrees, until the thigh is level with the torso. Squeeze one second, lower over 2 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back to kick higher. Letting the hip rotate open. Swinging the leg with momentum.

name: Fire hydrant
setup: On all fours, hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips.
posture: Flat back, hips level, core braced, weight evenly spread so the torso doesn't lean.
execution: Exhale and lift one knee out to the side, keeping it bent at 90 degrees, until the thigh is roughly parallel to the floor. Squeeze one second, lower over 2 seconds, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Leaning the torso away to lift the leg higher. Rotating the hips instead of moving only at the working hip.

name: Curtsy lunge
setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Feet hip width.
posture: Chest up, torso upright, hips as square as possible, core braced.
execution: Inhale and step one foot back and diagonally behind the other, lowering until the front thigh is near parallel. Drive through the front heel to return, exhaling.
commonMistakes: Crossing so far behind that the knee twists. Letting the torso rotate with the step. Letting the front knee cave inward.

name: Kettlebell sumo squat
setup: Stand with feet wider than shoulder width, toes turned out 30 to 45 degrees. Hold one kettlebell by the horns at chest height or hanging between the legs.
posture: Chest up, torso upright, core braced, knees pushed out to track over the toes.
execution: Inhale and squat straight down until the thighs are at least parallel. Drive up through the heels and squeeze the glutes at the top, exhaling.
commonMistakes: Letting the knees cave inward. Leaning forward as the bell pulls down.

name: Banded lateral walk
setup: Loop a band around the legs just above the knees or around the ankles. Feet hip width, quarter-squat position.
posture: Chest up, hips low in a quarter squat, core braced, feet pointing straight ahead throughout.
execution: Step sideways against the band, keeping constant tension and never letting the feet come fully together. Breathe steadily. Take the set number of steps each way.
commonMistakes: Standing up tall between steps, which kills the tension. Letting the feet turn outward. Letting the trailing foot snap in.

name: Standing calf raise machine
setup: Shoulders under the pads, balls of the feet on the platform edge, heels hanging free. Feet hip width, toes pointing straight ahead.
posture: Stand tall, knees almost straight with a soft bend, chest up, core braced.
execution: Inhale and lower the heels below the platform until you feel a deep calf stretch. Hold one second. Exhale and press up onto the toes as high as possible, squeezing one second at the top.
commonMistakes: Bouncing through short reps with no stretch or squeeze. Bending the knees to bounce the weight. Rushing, which is the most common calf mistake.

name: Seated calf raise machine
setup: Sit with the balls of the feet on the platform, pads snug across the lower thighs just above the knees.
posture: Sit tall, back straight, core lightly braced, knees bent at 90 degrees. This angle biases the soleus.
execution: Inhale and lower the heels for a deep stretch, hold one second. Exhale and press up as high as possible, squeezing one second at the top.
commonMistakes: Short bouncy reps. Setting the pad on the kneecap rather than the lower thigh.

name: Donkey calf raise
setup: Balls of the feet on a raised platform, hinged forward at the hips with the torso roughly parallel to the floor and the pad across the hips.
posture: Flat back, chest up, core braced, knees almost straight.
execution: Inhale and lower the heels for a deep stretch, hold one second. Exhale and press up as high as possible, squeezing one second.
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back in the hinged position. Bouncing without a full stretch.

name: Leg press calf raise
setup: Sit in the leg press with only the balls of the feet on the bottom edge of the platform, heels hanging off.
posture: Back and hips flat against the pad, legs almost straight with a soft knee bend. Keep the safeties engaged.
execution: Inhale and let the platform push the toes back into a deep stretch, hold one second. Exhale and press up as far as the ankles allow, squeezing one second.
commonMistakes: Letting the feet slip off the platform, which is genuinely dangerous under load. Bending the knees to press the weight.

name: Smith machine calf raise
setup: Bar on the upper traps, balls of the feet on a raised block or plate, heels hanging free.
posture: Stand tall, knees almost straight, chest up, core braced.
execution: Inhale and lower the heels for a deep stretch, hold one second. Exhale and press up as high as possible, squeezing one second at the top.
commonMistakes: Bouncing rapidly through a short range. Letting the block slide out from under the feet.

name: Barbell standing calf raise
setup: Bar on the upper traps as in a squat. Balls of the feet on a raised block, heels hanging free. Feet hip width.
posture: Stand tall, knees almost straight, chest up, core braced hard for balance.
execution: Inhale and lower the heels for a stretch, hold one second. Exhale and press up onto the toes, squeezing one second.
commonMistakes: Wobbling because balance is the limiting factor rather than the calves. Bouncing without a full range.

name: Dumbbell standing calf raise
setup: A dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Balls of the feet on a raised block, heels hanging free.
posture: Stand tall, chest up, knees almost straight, core braced.
execution: Inhale and lower the heels for a deep stretch, hold one second. Exhale and press up as high as possible, squeezing one second.
commonMistakes: Rushing the reps. Bending the knees to bounce the dumbbells up.

name: Single-leg dumbbell calf raise
setup: One dumbbell in the same-side hand, other hand on a support. Ball of the working foot on a raised block, other foot lifted.
posture: Stand tall, working knee almost straight, hips level, core braced.
execution: Inhale and lower the heel for a deep stretch, hold one second. Exhale and press up as high as possible, squeezing one second. Complete all reps, then switch.
commonMistakes: Pulling on the support to help. Bending the knee to bounce.

name: Bodyweight calf raise
setup: Stand with the balls of the feet on a step or raised edge, heels hanging free. Hand on a wall for balance.
posture: Stand tall, knees almost straight, chest up, core braced.
execution: Inhale and lower the heels for a deep stretch, hold one second. Exhale and press up as high as possible, squeezing one second at the top.
commonMistakes: Doing fast bouncy reps on flat ground with no stretch. Rushing through high rep counts.

name: Single-leg bodyweight calf raise
setup: Ball of one foot on a step, other foot lifted behind. Fingertips on a wall for balance only.
posture: Stand tall, working knee almost straight, hips level, core braced.
execution: Inhale and lower the heel for a deep stretch, hold one second. Exhale and press up as high as possible, squeezing one second. Complete all reps, then switch.
commonMistakes: Leaning on the wall to take load off. Cutting the stretch short at the bottom.

name: Band calf raise
setup: Sit with the legs extended and loop a band around the balls of the feet, holding both ends. Or stand on the band and hold the handles.
posture: Sit or stand tall, back straight, knees almost straight, core braced.
execution: Exhale and point the toes away against the band as far as they go, squeezing one second. Return over 2 to 3 seconds into a stretch, inhaling.
commonMistakes: Letting the band snap the feet back. Using so little tension there is no real resistance at the top.

name: Jump rope
setup: Rope length checked by standing on the middle, handles reaching roughly to the armpits. Feet together, rope behind the heels.
posture: Stand tall, chest up, elbows tucked close to the ribs, core braced, eyes forward. Wrists do the turning, not the arms.
execution: Jump about 2cm off the floor, landing softly on the balls of the feet with soft knees. Keep a steady rhythm for the set duration, breathing continuously.
commonMistakes: Jumping far higher than needed, which tires you out fast. Landing flat-footed or on the heels. Swinging from the shoulders instead of the wrists.
